quoted_text: Golden Trendsetter, a 2019 Dutch cultivar by Interplant, is an 80 cm upright shrub. With thorny stems and large glossy leaves, its 6–8 cm blooms flaunt a vivid golden-yellow hue with green hints and ruffled edges. Slightly fragrant, cut flowers last 10–12 days in vases but may develop green stamens. Highly disease-resistant, it’s ideal for gardens or commercial use, balancing bold color with easy care.
